text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Romania's RomTelecom telephone company announced rises in domestic telephone charges by 60 percent starting June.
- Sowing work was completed on 67 percent of farmland.
- Romania expects record grain crops this year, but it will face harvesting difficulties due to farm machinery shortage.
- Agriculture Ministry said it had postponed to 1998 its plans to liquidate or privatise 75 loss-making state farms selected for restructuring.

- Romania and U.S. helicopter maker Bell Helicopter will sign on May 21 a contract to privatise plane maker IAR in the Transylvanian city of Brasov. The country's defence ministry will sign a deal with the new company to buy the first 96 Cobra helicopters it will produce.
- The private sector took some 60 percent of Romanian exports this year.
- Parliament's upper house, the Senate, abrogated a 1993 law on state subsidies and soft loans for farmers.
- Prices for imported medicines fell by 15 percent over the past month, as the leu currency has stabilised.
